reuse.why: Adds the flag as an option of the existing shouldWriteMonthActionCategory predicate and has each action pass it through, rather than re-testing hidden flags per action.

duplication.why: The rule change itself is in one place; the only repetition is threading the same optional parameter through each action's signature and call, following the tree's existing per-action shape.

placement.why: The variation lives in the shared selection predicate in budget/actions.ts where the other exclusions are.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing and a test are added.

maintainability.why: Clean predicate change, but copyPreviousMonth, which also uses the predicate, is not given the flag, so month-wide actions now differ in what they accept, and the new signatures are left unformatted.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All touched actions go through shouldWriteMonthActionCategory; copyPreviousMonth still calls it but without the new option.
